notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for synchronization-point service reporting. The test composes an adapter-supplied application FOM and standard MIM, subscribes to HLAreportServiceInvocation through the public API, and verifies the standard Federation Management service reports for registration, confirmation, announcement, achievement, and completion, including report identity, reliable transportation, service type, supplied-argument shapes, Null return arguments, exception state, and serial progression. It also verifies the corresponding synchronization-point callbacks and failure-set semantics. Provider libraries, endpoint selection, callback model, and FOM/MIM paths remain adapter-owned; file-backed report storage and private implementation seams are outside this contract.
